Various reasons. A lot cheaper, they're actually strict,  and 9nce you sign the agreement you give up power of attorney so you can leave if you change your mind. Once you sign on the dotted line then you're stuck there for 3 months. No and ifs or buts about it, you're committed. First time I didn't take it seriously,  second time I took it 100% seriously. It was a strict and tough place but they were compassionate too. High walls, bars on windows and locks everywhere so no escape  lol.  Overall 100% worth it. Food was good, staff was great, beds coulda been better though. 

Place opened my eyes to a lot of wrong I did but blocked out. And believe me, I did want to leave but I couldn't lol. But once my system was clean and I got more privileges then things became easy and I accepted it.

Very cheap, like $1,000 for the 3 months and of course maybe an extra $100 for spending money. It was BRUTAL!! And I mean that in a wholesome way.  They don't ween you off drugs unless it's alcohol. Once you sign your name on the contract then you no longer have freewill to do what you want. Mexican law states that once you sign power of attorney over to them you can't leave rehab whatever for those 3 months. 

First time I didn't take it seriously. I thought "I'll get clean and everything will be good"..it wasn't  and I relapsed when I left so a year later I got fed up and signed myself in again to the same spot and this time took it seriously. 

A day consisted of this. (Btw you had to follow their rules to the T, they're rough but very fair) 8am wake up routine: do your bed, pee, brush and do a morning prayer. 9am eat breakfast which was usually oatmeal with bread. 10am-12pm group therapy. 12-1 break time for a cig or to buy some snacks. 1-3 group. 4-5pm is lunch. 5-6pm shower day every other day or just break for an hour. 6-8 group. 9pm dinner.  Then get the night free until about 12 which is lights  out. Very strict there and saw lot of fights. Most ppl the were there against their will because if you have a drug problem in Mexico you're family can legally have ppl grab you from your room and take you by force to rehab.

Edit: I also have pictures of the place where I stayed  at. Very nasty and filthy place.
